The environment disallows csv.DictWriter, so I will manually join the headers and rows using RFC-style field delimiters and write the backup again.

```python
lines = [','.join(['Title', 'Artists'])]
for row in csv_rows:
    lines.append(','.join([row['Title'], artist_field(row)]))
csv_content = '\n'.join(lines)
if file_exists_result['exists']:
    write_result = apis.file_system.update_file(
        file_path=backup_path,
        content=csv_content,
        access_token=file_system_access_token
    )
else:
    write_result = apis.file_system.create_file(
        file_path=backup_path,
        content=csv_content,
        access_token=file_system_access_token,
        overwrite=False
    )
print(write_result)
```
